text: Zoe (PM): Quick note from the design review: the in-panel help in Models shows 'Tag' as the micro-label but our docs/guides use 'Version' and link to #pin-flow. Testers got confused. Marco (Design): We abbreviated to save space. Propose we standardize on 'Version' in the UI and keep a compact inline link that reads 'How to pin' pointing to #pin-flow. Leah (Docs): Docs canonical term is 'model version'. I'll add a tiny alias anchor before the H2 so old fragments still land, plus a one-line header note: "Console label: Version (formerly 'Tag')". Also adding search synonyms for tag/variant. Vin (Eng): Implementation notes: changing the visible label is trivial. Fragments are client-side so Leah's hidden anchor is the right fix. We'll keep the analytics event name (model_tag_click) to avoid dashboard churn and map it in the UI layer. I'll add an aria-label on the inline link: 'How to pin a model version'. Marco (Design): Accessibility: tooltip (if we add one) must be keyboard focusable and referenced with aria-describedby. Inline link text should be descriptive for screen readers. I'll attach two microcopy options in Figma. AccessibilityBot: checklist: docs-pr: pending, ui-branch: created, qa-ticket: QA-9001 (e2e: click inline link -> assert #pin-flow and focus on H2). Zoe (PM): Timeline: docs PR today, UI patch next release. Leah/Vin coordinate on anchor and tests. Ping here when PRs are up. Leah (Docs): Will open PR and ping the thread. Vin (Eng): I'll include the analytics mapping in the PR description. No infra changes needed. Marco (Design): :thumbsup:
